name: baseshot
description: Read your BaseShot screenshots, recordings, and transcripts, search your library, and manage files and comments from the chat.

interface.longDescription:
BaseShot is where your team shares screenshots and screen recordings. Connect it and ChatGPT can work with them right in the chat.

Paste a BaseShot link to get a summary of a recording, pull out the steps with timestamps, or read the text in a screenshot. Search your library by file name or by what was said in a recording. Catch up on comments and reply to teammates without switching apps. Rename a file, move it to another workspace, or change who can open it.

ChatGPT only reaches what your own BaseShot account can reach, and it checks with you before deleting anything.
defaultPrompt: Find my recording about the checkout bug in BaseShot.
Summarize this BaseShot recording with timestamps.

positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the checkout bug report, with timestamps from the transcript.
